violations.description: Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --An approved sanitizer was not used during three compartment sink operation. Employee stated that dishes for food storage were being cleaned in the single sink up front. They were not being sanitized.--Three compartment sink was not designed and/or constructed properly. The single sink up front was being used to wash dishes. This needs to be done at the three compartment in the back.
Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not covered or inverted during storage. Plates on the storage rack under the microwave were not covered or inverted.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. The new walls in the kitchen area are bare Sheetrock. This needs to be finished or covered with a surface that is cleanable.
Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage * was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. The ice chute on the soda dispenser needs to be cleaned.
Clean/dry location, protected, covered, original containers, labeled (2 pts deducted)
